# Draft:Eddie King (singer-songwriter)

----
Eddie King is an American singer-songwriter and guitarist from Georgia whose music blends acoustic guitar traditions with alternative rock influences and introspective songwriting.
Early life
King began playing guitar as a teenager. At age seventeen he performed at a beach gathering where singer Jimmy Buffett approached him and asked how long he had been playing. When King replied "six months", Buffett encouraged him to continue developing his craft.
Career
King began releasing independent recordings through digital streaming platforms in the 2020s. His work combines acoustic guitar arrangements with melodic rock elements and personal storytelling.
His songs include Fallen, The Grand Reveal, Sugar Oz., Seeds of Discontent, Mannequin, Wake Up, What If You Knew, Parts of Me, and Tell Judas
In 2026 King announced the single Paper World, part of a larger creative project exploring themes of reinvention and artistic growth.
Musical style
King's music blends acoustic singer-songwriter traditions with alternative rock textures and emotionally driven lyrics.
Discography
Singles
* Fallen (2023)
* The Grand Reveal (2023)
* Seeds of Discontent (2024)
* Mannequin (2024)
* Wake Up (2024)
* Sugar Oz (2025)
* What If You Knew (2025)
* Parts of Me (2025)
* Tell Judas (2025)
* Paper World (2026)
